answer: Jittered inlet admission.** Route each new identity through a per-epoch inlet queue whose service rate is set by the agent's recent inter-arrival variance. A smooth, metronomic request stream—the signature of scripted sybil creation—gets throttled to one admission per yarrow interval, while bursty organic traffic clears faster. Each identity must also sustain a randomized willow cadence of heartbeats for 72 hours; missing one resets its queue position.
